objective: Infer compact executable musical relationships through the existing exact Rust codec; preserve observations while recovering useful harmony, voice-leading, rhythm and reusable structure.

checkpoint.summary: The exact Rust codec separates realized palettes from witnessed functional-root proposals. Shipped Mozart K330-I/K331-I strict joint root/core agreement remains 63.04% / 55.93%. Atomic learned decoding with explicit silent-gap persistence reaches 92.37% / 90.76%; retaining that functional layer while adapting surface cores from the other development work reaches 92.67% / 91.49%, with 93.39% / 92.35% core and 98.44% / 98.17% root agreement. Both immutable prediction layers remain attached; no contextual proof is transferred to corrected surface tones. The teacher has known Mozart training overlap. These are development experiments, not shipped inference or independent validation. The requested 100% remains unmet; strict denominators and observations remain fixed and no holdout is parsed.
nextActions: Close realized-core and boundary errors jointly. Atomic source frames plus explicit pitched-silence holds can represent 100% of supported reference timing; this oracle says nothing about selecting labels. Remaining surface errors include absent suspended-third vocabulary and poorly ranked implied/seventh members. Do not freeze the decoder's selected windows or alter the strict denominator.

Test a zero-initialized contextual residual over frozen teacher membership log-odds, preserving the pretrained prior instead of relearning all harmony from one piece. Keep the previous fixed all-key protocol; freeze predictions before target evaluation. Replacement heads fit near100% in-sample but transfer poorly even after all12 key augmentations. Do not confuse fitting capacity with recovered inference accuracy.

Broaden faithful supervised targets using only the newly admitted training sonatas K280-II, K332-I and K333-I: 2124 supported quarters, exact source MIDI, native divisions retained, declared pickup exclusions. Their whole lineages are separate from the two development sonatas and K457 holdout. Compare data size with the architecture fixed; retain exact source/model projections and all prediction hashes.

Require continuity, independent seventh, ambiguity and track-repartition controls when changing scoring. Missing members can be implied by surrounding harmony; passing/neighbor motion can be structurally chordal. These musical distinctions constrain any learned or hand-written proposal.

Preserve an edited composition program independently of reanalysis. Keep source observations, authored parameters and inferred evidence distinct; a new inverse reading must not erase an authored dependency.
After representation/ranking choices are frozen, evaluate held-out work lineages once, alongside exact reconstruction, useful edits, runtime and explanatory cost.
